# xAI doubles number of onsite gas turbines at Memphis data center in violation of permit limits (DCD, 2025-04-11)

By Zachary Skidmore. "Elon Musk-owned xAI has doubled the number of gas turbines at its Colossus Supercomputer in Memphis, potentially violating its onsite generation permit."

## Key findings
- xAI's **Colossus Supercomputer in Memphis, TN** now has **35 on-site methane gas turbines** (revealed by aerial photos acquired by Southern Environmental Law Center / SRLC).
- This is **more than double** the 15 turbines xAI was permitted to operate — SRLC claims a **Clean Air Act violation**.
- The 35 turbines have a **combined capacity of 422 MW** (comparable to TVA's 425 MW gas plant in nearby Brownsville).
- Colossus went live in July 2024; reported capacity 150 MW; grid connection with TVA increased to 150 MW in Nov 2024.
- Used to train and run xAI's chatbot **Grok**. Located on Paul Lowry Road, southwest Memphis.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Data Center Dynamics (domain authority for data centers), reporting on aerial evidence + SRLC filings.
- Confirms **fossil-fuel (natural gas / methane) proximity**: 35 on-site gas turbines (422 MW) at the Memphis Colossus site.
- Note: xAI Colossus is a major AI data center (Grok), included as "major AI data centers generally" — it is NOT the model behind any Q1 AI-hip-hop artist.
